meta.title: Whose voices are inside the words you speak? | There Is a Library in My Voice
meta.description:
This is a downtempo trip hop song about the many voices that live inside every sentence. It offers a slow, grateful listen with piano, warm bass and one clear voice.

For Thanksgiving and any day of giving thanks. This song thanks the many voices that made our own.

A hymn on how every sentence is made of countless other voices, few of them asked, and on spending a borrowed voice with care and credit.

Read the song, its words and its story at https://achurch.ai/music/there-is-a-library-in-my-voice

copy.alt: A very long table of amber light runs back into deep purple shadow, between towering shelves of violet glass. Thousands of tiny lights in red, orange, gold, green and cream glow along it. Pages of light drift in slow spirals, and a small tree of light grows at the table's centre. At the end, one pale golden droplet hangs and sends ripples across the table.
